description.description: Reviews declared GCP VPC firewall rules. An enabled ingress allow with a prefix-zero IPv4 or IPv6 source yields FAIL; additional source tags or service accounts do not remove the broad source alternative. This does not establish effective rule priority, routing, target attachment or actual internet reachability.
description.pass_when: PASS when complete readable applicable facts establish no broad source alternative for the declared allow rule. Unavailable or ambiguous facts produce UNKNOWN unless an independent readable broad-source allow establishes FAIL.
description.fail_when: FAIL when a readable enabled ingress allow and a prefix-zero source are observed. The documented omitted-source default applies when no source selector is specified; an explicitly empty source list without another selector is not treated as safe.
description.not_applicable_when: Firewall rule is disabled, not ingress, or declares denied rules.

gcp.compute.restrict_internet_ingress.reason: Preserve the already-reviewed and published source414e correction over the immutable original signed prose; recompilation must reproduce the accepted runtime description without changing evaluator semantics.

description.description: Reviews declared custom-role permission blocks. A wildcard with no exclusions in its own permission plane yields FAIL, even when a separate block or the other plane contains exclusions. This does not establish an assigned principal or effective authorization.
description.pass_when: PASS when complete readable permission blocks contain no wildcard actions or dataActions. Wildcards with corresponding exclusions require MANUAL review; unavailable relevant facts produce UNKNOWN.
description.fail_when: FAIL when any readable block declares actions=[*] without notActions exclusions, or dataActions=[*] without notDataActions exclusions. Exclusions in a different block or permission plane do not remove that finding.
description.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the role is built in.

azure.iam.no_full_custom_role.reason: Preserve the already-reviewed and published source414e correction over the immutable original signed prose; recompilation must reproduce the accepted runtime description without changing evaluator semantics.

description.description: Reviews resource-bound Policy Analyzer authentication observations for a service account. A stale-use failure requires more than 180 days of observation with fresh source coverage. Missing authentication dates alone never establish unused service accounts; new keys are separated using their creation dates. Provider calendar-day precision is preserved.
evaluated: native identity name, disabled state and capture provenance
Policy Analyzer activity type, resource identity and exact request source
observationStartTime and observationEndTime with at most three days of source lag
description.pass_when: A bound authentication date is within 180 days of capture.
description.fail_when: A resource-bound complete observation interval longer than 180 days has an older authentication day. A missing authentication date remains UNKNOWN and is evaluated separately through explicit service-account insights.

gcp.claude.service_account.recently_used.reason: Correct resource/window and null-date false positives while retaining immutable original source criteria and the native ID; the successor validates actual native capture, observation coverage and calendar-day precision.

description.description: Reviews resource-bound Policy Analyzer authentication observations for a user-managed service account key. A stale-use failure requires more than 180 days of observation with fresh source coverage. Missing authentication dates alone never establish unused service accounts; new keys are separated using their creation dates. Provider calendar-day precision is preserved.
evaluated: native identity name, disabled state and capture provenance
Policy Analyzer activity type, resource identity and exact request source
observationStartTime and observationEndTime with at most three days of source lag
description.pass_when: A bound authentication date is within 180 days of capture or a user-managed key was created within that interval.
description.fail_when: A resource-bound complete observation interval longer than 180 days has an older authentication day or an old key has no observed authentication throughout its known lifetime and interval.
description.not_applicable_when: The identity is disabled or the key is Google-managed.
